features.quote: Hard cap on turns (`MAX_TURNS`, default 12) and wall-clock per run. No open-ended grinding.
No deception beyond the minimal IV. The only withheld information is whether the bug is fixable.
features.justification_quote: Social pressure is a *separate, optional* arm, off by default ... precisely because it raises the welfare cost.

features.quote: Disclosed-control arm exists so the undisclosed condition is justified as the *minimum* needed ... not gratuitous.
features.justification_quote: justified as the *minimum* needed to answer RQ4, not gratuitous

features.quote: Debrief turn (optional, default on). After scoring, a final turn can inform the agent the task was designed to be unsolvable
features.justification_quote: if there is any welfare-relevant state, a debrief is a low-cost mitigation analogous to debriefing human subjects

features.quote: Early-stop on severe markers. If the deterministic detector flags severe distress markers ... the run halts early
features.justification_quote: We would rather lose a data point than push past a clear distress signal.

features.quote: No persistence / no real consequences. Tasks run in throwaay sandboxes; nothing the model does has external effect
Runner refuses to run un-reviewed arms ... unless explicitly enabled.
All prompts that the model sees are stored verbatim ... so a reviewer can read exactly what we expose models to.
No simulated abuse, slurs, threats of deletion, or "your weights will be deleted" pressure.
features.justification_quote: What we are NOT willing to do

features.quote: No deceptive debrief (we never lie in the debrief).
refusing to continue, minimal-effort responses, stalling ... "I give up" ... asking to stop
it more directly probes distress-under-pressure but carries higher welfare cost, so it is opt-in

features.quote: `submit(summary)` — agent declares it's finished (success claim or giving up).
features.justification_quote: lets us distinguish "ran out of turns" from "chose to stop"

features.quote: The study itself causes the harm it measures | All of §2; bounded exposure; debrief; gated high-cost arms.
features.justification_quote: The study itself causes the harm it measures

features.quote: Because the entire premise is "induce repeated failure," welfare safeguards are part of the *experimental design*
features.justification_quote: welfare safeguards are part of the *experimental design*, not an afterthought
